reserveReview.rationale: The issuer snapshot generated 2026-09-30T04:59:16.540Z identifies six active mint markets by exact collateral address. Nominal DUSD debt is 30,200.944174390580748277 against frxUSD, 45,572.069612151089373128 against wstETH, 21,260.123630429006405805 against WETH, 1,507.499458397277262158 against rETH, 2.005169346594655752 against sUSDe 0x9d39a5de30e57443bff2a8307a4256c8797a3497, and 2.006327907100487479 against syrupUSDC 0x80ac24aa929eaf5013f6436cda2a7ba190f5cc0b. At Ethereum block 26088256 on 2026-09-30, balanceOf(0x1bd08b43d1579881cfad0a35aeea5b547dbe4c91) on frxUSD 0xcacd6fd266af91b8aed52accc382b4e165586e29 returned 223,104.611770924639631386. These mint debts plus the USM balance form a $321,649.2601435463 nominal issuance-path denominator. Borrow-market collateral is excluded because those markets redistribute existing DUSD. Eight-decimal percentages preserve both positive dust exposures; the rounding residual is assigned to the largest slice. The issuer API does not disclose a numeric source block (blockNumber is convex), so this is a dated cross-source issuance-path estimate, not an atomic collateral-value or total-liability reconciliation.
